data.title: AI | China’s AI Industry Shifts Toward Agents, Report Says
data.description:
China’s artificial intelligence industry is moving away from competition in large models and computing power and toward deploying and commercializing AI agents, according to Bloomberg reported.

The shift was cited in a report by the China Telecom Research Institute and aired by China Central Television on Saturday.

data.title: KPMG China Says Energy Has Become a Board-Level Variable for Large Companies
data.description:
KPMG China said energy has moved from a cost item to a board-level operating variable for large companies, as Jiemian News reported on September 11 during the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services. KPMG China Energy Transition and Circular Economy lead partner Li Jing said firms now face three simultaneous changes: shifting prices as power market rules evolve and China expands its carbon market to steel, cement and aluminum smelting; customers demanding proof of emissions, energy sources and accounting methods; and AI computing reshaping electricity demand from an access issue into a planning issue.

Li said the rules for Chinese energy companies going overseas have changed, citing the EU carbon border adjustment mechanism taking effect from 2026, the European Commission's Foreign Subsidies Regulation and the U.S. Inflation Reduction Act and related tax guidance. He said project returns are now shaped by product pricing, customer access, supply-chain structure and tax eligibility, while overseas project cash flow does not guarantee money can be repatriated to the parent group. He also said companies should stress-test major overseas investments against carbon-border rules, subsidies, critical minerals, trade restrictions, data rules and localization requirements.

China's 15th Five-Year Plan for the energy system sets a 2030 target to initially build a new power system, including a 50% share of non-fossil power generation, high-level consumption of more than 2.8 billion kilowatts of new energy, charging infrastructure for more than 110 million electric vehicles, around 410 million kilowatts of conventional hydropower, about 110 million kilowatts of nuclear power, and about 65 million kilowatts of biomass, solar thermal, geothermal and marine energy capacity. KPMG China board member and Asia-Pacific and China energy, natural resources and chemicals lead partner Cai Zhongquan said these targets mean energy companies need systemic restructuring, not incremental optimization, and should expand into new businesses such as direct green power supply, zero-carbon parks and vehicle-grid interaction.

Li said short-duration storage, especially on the grid side and in commercial and industrial use, is the most likely area for near-term commercialization, while hydrogen is unlikely to achieve an economic breakthrough within two to three years. He said the real winners in the next two to three years will be scenarios whose revenue mechanisms are first recognized by rules, rather than technologies with the fastest cost declines.

data.title: China's August auto retail sales rose 5.5% month on month, Cui Dongshu says
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Cui Dongshu, secretary general of the China Passenger Car Association's branch, said August 2026 auto retail sales rose 5.5% month on month, driven by high oil prices, weaker macro conditions, rising policy expectations, and the Chengdu Auto Show. He said geopolitical conflict continued to disrupt navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, keeping international oil prices at a high level, while domestic gasoline prices in 2026 have been raised by more than 1,720 yuan per ton in total, including a 180 yuan increase since late July, sharply lifting the cost of owning fuel vehicles and causing domestic demand for fuel passenger cars to shrink sharply. He added that manufacturing PMI rose 0.6 percentage point month on month to 49.8% in August, still below the boom-bust line, and that terminal demand and foot traffic showed a pattern of weakness early in the month and improvement later on.

data.title: TuringQ Unveils Gen3 Chip-Scale Scalable Photonic Quantum Computer
data.description:
TuringQ founder Jin Xianmin has officially launched TuringQ Gen3, a large-scale chip-level scalable photonic quantum computer, described as the world’s first cabinetized chip-level scalable photonic quantum computer. According to ChainCatcher, the system was announced at a forum session focused on industrial and scientific integration.

TuringQ Gen3 uses a high-speed programmable thin-film lithium niobate photonic quantum chip and integrates core modules including a quantum light source, programmable photonic processing chip, single-photon detection, and quantum-classical heterogeneous computing. The company said the system supports chip-level scaling to single-chip, 10,000-photon and million-mode computing resources, and is intended to verify chip-level quantum advantage while exploring AI directions such as world models.

TuringQ recently completed the filing for IPO counseling and plans to pursue an A-share listing. The counseling institution is Guotai Haitong.

data.title: Hong Kong IPO Market Raises HK$364.176 Billion So Far This Year
data.description: Hong Kong's IPO market has been active this year, with total fundraising, including overallotments, exceeding HK$360 billion and ranking among the world's leading exchanges. According to Odaily, Wind data showed that as of September 11, 108 new shares had listed in Hong Kong this year, raising HK$364.176 billion, up 60% in number of listings and 161.38% in fundraising from the same period in 2025. Several A-share leaders, including Shingho Technology, Luxshare Precision, and Innolight, have also listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

data.title: Revolut Confirms Fake Government Email Exposed Passports And Bitcoin Records
data.description:
Revolut confirmed that a fake government email tricked it into handing over customer files that included passports, selfies and Bitcoin records, while saying systems and customer funds were unaffected. According to BeInCrypto, the bank said it blocked the sender after spotting the issue and notified the agency, police and data protection and financial regulators.

The notices to customers said the leak also included driving licences, home addresses and bank statements, and that only biometric facial telemetry was excluded. Blockchain investigator ZachXBT flagged the breach, which Revolut said affected a limited number of users.

data.title: HSBC Begins Search for Next Chief Financial Officer
data.description: HSBC Holdings Plc is set to begin looking for a new chief financial officer, according to Bloomberg. The bank is considering internal and external candidates for one of the biggest jobs in global finance after Pam Kaur unexpectedly said Thursday she will retire from the role in 2027.

data.title: Trader 0x039's 8x ETH Long Turns Profitable After Price Rebounds Above Entry
data.description:
According to Arkham monitoring, trader 0x039 deposited funds into a new wallet two weeks ago and opened an 8x leveraged ETH long position on Hyperliquid. According to ChainCatcher, the position had an unrealized loss of about $4.9 million 10 days ago when ETH touched $2,372.

ETH has since recovered above the trader's entry price of $2,486, and the long position is now up $1.98 million.

data.title: Crypto Liquidations Hit $674 Million in 24 Hours, Coinglass Data Shows
data.description:
Coinglass data shows that crypto liquidations across the market totaled $674 million in the past 24 hours, with $292 million in long positions and $381 million in short positions. According to ChainCatcher, Bitcoin liquidations included $89.45 million in longs and $94.27 million in shorts, while Ethereum liquidations included $96.74 million in longs and $215 million in shorts.

Over the same period, 94,554 traders were liquidated worldwide, and the largest single liquidation occurred on Hyperliquid's ETH-USD pair at $20.28 million.

data.title: Pezeshkian Says Iran Will Not Yield After U.S. And Israel Conflict
data.description: According to CNBC, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Iran will not surrender and has resisted aggression from the U.S. and Israel, telling a gathering of Indian religious leaders in New Delhi late Friday that the country will not yield to what he called bullying arrogance. His remarks came ahead of the BRICS Summit in India and followed U.S. President Donald Trump’s claim that Iran would have wiped out Israel and the Middle East, and started hitting U.S. cities, if Washington had not taken military action against Iran. Pezeshkian, on his first visit to India, also met Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday, when Modi raised concerns about the safety of seafarers and called for peace, freedom of navigation and commerce, and a resolution through dialogue and diplomacy. The article said shipments of oil and other cargoes through the Strait of Hormuz have slowed sharply since the U.S. and Israel began their war on Iran on Feb. 28, while global crude prices have surged and India remains highly exposed to supply disruptions because it imports nearly 85% of its fuel needs.

data.title: Bitcoin Rally Pushes Investor Sentiment to Near Two-Year High, CryptoQuant Analyst Says
data.description:
CryptoQuant analyst Darkfost said Bitcoin's latest rally has lifted investor sentiment to its most optimistic level in nearly two years, with a related market sentiment gauge briefly rising above 89 and entering the extreme greed zone. According to ChainCatcher, the last similar reading was seen in March 2024.

Darkfost said overly optimistic or pessimistic sentiment often warrants attention for possible trend reversals. The indicator has since eased from its earlier euphoric level and is moving back toward a more normal range, while Bitcoin is trying to hold its current level.

data.title: IG Holds 52% Chance to Beat AL in LPL Playoff Prediction Market
data.description:
The predict.fun market for the LPL playoff matchup between IG and AL shows IG with a 52% chance of winning. According to Odaily, the LPL playoff losers' bracket final between IG and AL is scheduled for 5 p.m. today in a best-of-five series.

The winner will advance to tomorrow's LPL final against BLG for the championship, while the loser will be eliminated from the playoffs. Both teams have already secured spots in the winners' bracket of the World Championship qualification stage, so either side can still reach Worlds through the qualifiers if it loses this match.

IG reached the playoffs through the Knights' Road and then defeated TES 3-2, WE 3-1, and LGD 3-0. AL beat LGD 3-1 in the first playoff round before losing 0-3 to BLG in the winners' bracket final.

data.title: Lil Durk Acquitted In Federal Murder-For-Hire Case
data.description: According to the BBC, Grammy-winning rapper Lil Durk was acquitted on Friday of all charges in a federal murder-for-hire case that accused him of orchestrating a revenge killing in Los Angeles four years ago. The Chicago artist, whose legal name is Durk Devontay Banks, was arrested in 2024 and had faced five felony counts, including murder for hire resulting in death and conspiracy; he remains in custody ahead of a separate trial on 5 October on racketeering murder and firearms charges. Defense lawyer Drew Findling said Banks was thankful after the verdict, while First Assistant US Attorney Bill Essayli said prosecutors look forward to presenting evidence at the second trial. Two co-defendants, Deandre "OTF Dede" Wilson and David "Browneyez" Lindsey, were convicted of stalking and conspiracy to commit stalking but were acquitted of murder-for-hire charges. The case stemmed from an August 2022 shooting at a Los Angeles petrol station that killed Saviay'a Robinson, the cousin of rival rapper Quando Rondo, whose real name is Tyquian Bowman.
